answer: Rotating terrace assignment. Each epoch, a public beacon emits verifiable randomness that assigns every registered agent to a random terrace (shard) for the next round. An attacker cannot precompute which shard a fresh identity lands in, so pre-staging colluding accounts fails. To occupy a shard at its zenith, the attacker must register identities blind and pay a per-identity crystal registration plus the cost of surviving random reshuffles across epochs.
